full_prompt_en: A square hand-drawn comic illustration shows a tiny masked adventurer riding a ramshackle flying machine through a mostly empty cream-colored background. A large, loosely brushed golden disk glows behind the character near the upper left, while pale brown splashes and scattered specks break the open paper surface. The little rider sits just left of center, with an oversized dark teal helmet and two round white eyes. Short pointed ears or fins rise from the helmet, and a small red mark sits at the chest. A ragged crimson cape streams dramatically toward the right, dividing into torn, flame-like points. The character's gloved hands grip a thin steering bar, blue trousers bend forward, and heavy brown boots jut out from the compact wooden and metal machine. Beneath the machine, a small greenish plume or splash touches the ground, suggesting a bounce or low flight. On the right, a tall black streetlamp rises above a rough gray wall or ledge; below it sit a wooden barrel and a round reddish object. These grounded props make the rider appear very small. The lower edge carries a narrow broken ground line, while most of the upper and left background stays unfilled. Warm diffuse light comes from the golden disk and pale paper, giving the forms soft highlights; dark ink hatching supplies more of the volume than cast shadows do. Scratchy contour lines, watercolor-like stains, and uneven washes keep even the fanciful action tactile and informal. The overall composition combines a large quiet field with one off-center burst of movement in muted teal, rusty red, brown, and warm cream.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形手绘漫画插画呈现一个戴面具的小冒险者骑着拼装飞行器，穿过大片留白的奶油色背景。上方偏左有一轮松笔刷出的金色大圆盘在人物身后发光，浅棕色泼痕与散点打破开阔纸面。小骑手坐在中央略偏左的位置，戴着比例夸张的深青绿色头盔，露出两只圆白眼。短尖耳或翼片从头盔上竖起，胸前有一处小红标记。破旧的深红披风向右戏剧性飘展，分裂成撕裂的火焰状尖角。戴手套的双手握住细操纵杆，蓝色裤腿向前弯，厚重棕靴从紧凑的木质与金属机器上伸出。机器下方，一小股浅绿色羽雾或溅痕触到地面，暗示一次弹跳或低飞。右侧一盏高高的黑色街灯升过粗糙的灰墙或台沿，下面放着木桶和一件圆形红褐物体。这些落地道具让骑手显得格外小。下缘只留一道断续的地面线，上方与左侧大部分背景保持空白。暖而漫射的光来自金色圆盘和浅色纸面，给形体柔和亮部；体积更多依靠深墨排线而非投影。刮擦般的轮廓、水彩式污渍和不匀的淡染，让奇幻动作仍有可触的随意感。整体构图以大片安静空间衬托一股偏心的动势，色彩集中在低调青绿、锈红、棕色与暖奶油色。
style_prompt_en: The illustration combines energetic ink drawing with thin, uneven washes on a warm paper ground. Oversized rounded shapes, small angular points, and ragged trailing contours create an elastic comic rhythm. Dark crosshatching and scratchy outlines give compact forms weight, while watercolor blooms, splatters, and visible paper grain keep the larger field loose. Muted teal and rusty red accents sit inside an expansive cream and ochre palette. Soft ambient brightness leaves the background open; concentrated dark marks, rather than heavy cast shadows, define the focal mass. The result is playful and slightly weathered, with a lively off-center gesture surrounded by generous negative space.
style_prompt_zh: 这类插画把有活力的墨线绘制与暖纸底上的薄而不匀的淡染结合起来。夸大的圆润形、细小尖角和破碎拖曳的轮廓形成有弹性的漫画节奏。深色交叉排线与刮擦般外线给紧凑形体重量，水彩晕斑、飞溅和可见纸纹则让大片色域保持松弛。低调青绿与锈红点缀落在宽阔的奶油和赭色调之中。柔和环境亮度使背景敞开；焦点色块主要由集中的深色线迹，而非厚重投影界定。结果俏皮又略显磨旧，一股活跃的偏心动势被充足留白包围。
theme_en: A tiny masked adventurer riding a ramshackle flying machine past a streetlamp
theme_zh: 戴面具的小冒险者骑着拼装飞行器掠过街灯
name: Skottie Young
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
